title: How Being a Good Pastor Made Me An Atheist

top_liked.author: @Haddonfield63
top_liked.text: It’s nice to hear a former pastor admit these things. I’ve tried so hard to hold on to this belief and going against my better judgment. I finally said no more. I felt so heavy trying to hold on to belief. Now I feel free.

top_liked.author: @StevenKim-f8p
top_liked.text:
This video is very eye opening to me, because I was raised in a Pentecostal church, and figured out they're all faking it at around 10.
I then moved to a mainline church because at least I know these people are "not faking it".
And your experience is basically the other side or…

top_liked.author: @stephp8308
top_liked.text: I love hearing your perspective. I still believe in a Creator, but I no longer ascribe to Christianity. It feels good to be free of it after all this time.
